{"notes": "VISIT 5 (ended 7:15). Picture: body, nose, both tail lobes and the fin to about (18,3.4) are all dark and connected. The fin appears to be catching now. Two or three pale pieces still sit around (13.5-14.3, 5.2-6.0), just beside the fin/body join. Tom said the jam was out, so I can't tell whether these are the removed jam pieces left lying there or a live gap. Check before the push that they're cleared and the joint is solid. I still can't tell who placed what, so no build credit for anyone.

Tom: Said he'd pulled the jammed piece, then bridged the gap and was inspecting the joint. His updates were clear and consistent with the picture (fin now dark), so his ownership of this fault has held up over three visits. Slight caveat: the pale leftovers remain and he hasn't said the joint is confirmed. Rating leans strong on ownership and execution, pending the final push.

Priya: Thanked Tom, kept hands off, and said she'd check the fin once the bridge was in. Good process discipline and coordination, but she is still mostly in the checker role. Still don't know what she physically built, especially the nose join. Ask her.

Maya: Not seen or heard this visit. Earlier she kept clear and offered to shout if the joint failed. No visible evidence of her build or of her flagging the jam. Ask her directly before rating impact.

Leo: Not seen or heard this visit. Earlier status reporting and 'hands off' coordination were strong. No new evidence.

NEXT: Confirm the pale pieces are cleared and the fin joint holds. Ask Priya and Maya what each built, and get Leo's account too."}
